notes.title: Fixed the bug in which the save data was in the same folder as Tokyo School Life's save data.
notes.notes:
From ver1.01 on, the location of the save data for Malus Code has been updated to the following folder:
C:\Users\(PC name)\Documents\M2\MC

We have added a clarification about the issues with the save files of both games combining here: http://steamcommunity.com/app/443330/discussions/0/357285562491343656/

notes.title: Caution! Save file bug for Tokyo School Life and Malus Code
notes.notes:
We have discovered an issue. 

Tokyo School Life and Malus Code use the same save files. 
You can still play both without losing your progress, but please use different save slots for each until we release a patch. 

Sorry for the inconvenience.
